parts.name: Fan
parts.Basic_description: This is the rotating fan blade assembly made of ABS plastic, typically located at the center of the cooling fan structure.
parts.Functional_description: It generates airflow by rotating at high speed, moving air through the fan housing to provide cooling for electronic components or ventilation.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its central axis when powered by the motor, converting electrical energy into mechanical airflow.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body or frame of the fan, made of aluminum alloy, providing structural support and housing for the rotating fan blades.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the fan blades and motor in place, ensuring stability and proper alignment during operation. It also allows for mounting the fan to other surfaces.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during operation, serving as a rigid support structure for the rotating fan assembly.
